title: Rooms in Parallel
statement:
A studio has `k` identical rooms and receives `n` booking requests. Request `i` wants a room from time `s_i` up to, but not including, time `e_i`. A room can host one request at a time, and a new request may start at the exact moment the previous one in that room ends. You may reject any request.

Find the largest number of requests that can be accepted.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `s_i` and `e_i`.

## Output
Print the largest number of accepted requests.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 8000`
- `0 <= s_i < e_i <= 10^9`
